title: Marcos Jr. encourages voters to join BARMM polls: ‘Safeguard ballot integrity, preserve peace’
summary: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. encouraged qualified voters in the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao to take part in its historic parliamentary elections on Monday, September 14.
